description: Seed provenance for the DigiLine Free Talk corpus (personal, non-distributed build). The GENERATED corpus (authored banks + catalog fact atoms) is the priority answer source. The public-corpus database fallback is dataset dialogue shipped for LAST-RESORT use only; the owner takes responsibility for that use and DISTRIBUTION_GATE.md removes/replaces it before any distribution.
owner: project owner (personal build; takes responsibility for seed use)

generatedCorpus.origin: Composed from project-authored banks in tools/freechat/data/ + fact atoms (name/level/type/specialMoves/level-tier) read from app/src/main/assets/species_catalog.json. The catalog profile prose is never read by the generator.
generatedCorpus.priority: primary answer source (generated intent/reply matches > species-voice lines > intent fallbacks > database fallback)
generatedCorpus.authoringStatus: draft (owner approval pending; no line is claimed reviewed)
generatedCorpus.originalityGate: tools/freechat/validate_freechat.py: 8-word shingle overlap against species_catalog profiles, existing DigiLine packs and the legacy species-chat asset; banned assistant/out-of-world/third-party phrase lints.

databaseFallback.role: LAST RESORT ONLY - runtime may use these pairs only after generated matches, species-voice lines, intent fallbacks and authored deflection/confusion fallbacks have no answer.
databaseFallback.priorityGuarantee: The builder never mixes the two lanes: generated replies are never converted into DB pairs and DB pairs are never re-voiced into generated replies.

sources.name: Cornell Movie-Dialogs Corpus
sources.usage: Dataset dialogue shipped verbatim in database_fallback.json for this personal build only. Distribution gate must remove/replace this asset.

sources.name: OpenAssistant Conversations (OASST1)
sources.usage: Dataset dialogue shipped verbatim in database_fallback.json for this personal build only. The supplied sample contained no pt-BR rows, so no oasst1-pt pairs shipped.
sources.distribution: Apache-2.0 permits redistribution with attribution; still last-resort dataset dialogue, not re-voiced.

sources.name: SODA (Social Dialogue Dataset)
sources.usage: Dataset dialogue shipped verbatim in database_fallback.json for this personal build only.
sources.distribution: CC BY 4.0 permits redistribution with attribution; still last-resort dataset dialogue, not re-voiced.

databaseFallback.filtering: Deduped on normalized (user, response); dropped empty/too-short rows, assistant-phrase rows, PII-looking rows (e-mail, URL, @handle, phone/SSN-like digit runs), sexual/romance rows, abusive/profanity rows; response <= 300 chars, user <= 300 chars; at most 300 pt pairs (none available); deterministic sorted selection capped at 5,000 pairs; source+license kept per pair.
databaseFallback.distributionGate: DISTRIBUTION_GATE.md owns removal/replacement. Options: strip database_fallback.json + the manifest databaseFallback key (runtime then relies on generated content only), or replace it with owner-authored/cleared dialogue while keeping the same schema.

seeds.name: Cornell Movie-Dialogs Corpus
seeds.license: No license stated; extracted movie-script dialogue (research distribution)
seeds.usage: Database fallback pairs only (last resort). Never used to compose generated replies.

seeds.name: OpenAssistant Conversations (OASST1)
seeds.usage: Database fallback pairs (en sample). Also usable offline for prompter-phrase mining (--seed-pairs) for authored match-phrase banks; seed text is never copied into generated replies.

seeds.name: SODA (Social Dialogue Dataset)
seeds.usage: Database fallback pairs only (last resort). Never used to compose generated replies.

seeds.name: DailyDialog
seeds.usage: Not supplied for the ship pack this pass; if supplied, offline mining/DB-fallback candidates only (NC terms), never used to compose generated replies.

seeds.name: EmpatheticDialogues
seeds.usage: Reference for comfort/boundary dialogue acts only; not shipped this pass.

seeds.name: Ubuntu Dialogue Corpus
seeds.license: No explicit data license (IBM 2015 generator; IRC logs)
seeds.usage: Technical register is off-brief for a companion chat; excluded.

seeds.name: OpenSubtitles / OPUS
seeds.usage: Subtitle text is copyrighted and off-world for this feature; excluded.

seeds.name: tools/freechat/data/*.json (topics, intents, grounding, chips, fallbacks, safety)
seeds.license: Project-owned original writing (all rights reserved by the project)
seeds.usage: Composes every generated reply; no external text and no catalog profile prose.

seeds.name: app/src/main/assets/species_catalog.json
seeds.usage: Fact atoms only: name, level, type, specialMoves, level->tier. Profile prose is never read by the builder and never shipped as free-talk speech.

seeds.name: app/src/main/assets/digiline/v1/en/*.json, species_chat_examples.json
seeds.license: Project packs (style pattern only) / third-party legacy game text (reference only)
seeds.usage: Style/register references and originality-gate reference corpora. No text is copied into Free Talk replies.

seeds.name: digimon_chat_export/ (Time Stranger DCO mod, Cyber Sleuth quiz, SMT V negotiation)
seeds.usage: Data-shape and coverage reference for the existing DigiLine v2 card packs; never used as Free Talk reply text.

seedPairsInput.note: Seed files are owner-provided and git-ignored. The database fallback asset is deterministic for a given seed set; the generated corpus is byte-identical whether or not any seed flag is passed.

distributionGate.requiredBeforeDistribution: Remove or owner-clear database_fallback.json (and its manifest key) and replace any NC/NC-SA or research-only pairs; verify generated corpus originality gate; keep the catalog-fact-atom citation policy.
distributionGate.generatedCorpusStatus: Authored original writing for this project - no distribution blocker from seed text.
